remediated_findings.finding: Cancellation could append a file after evidence sealing, invalidating the completed receipt.
remediated_findings.remediation: Cancellation and finalization share a bounded-wait control lock; lock files are excluded from immutable evidence and cancellation is checked during sealing.

remediated_findings.finding: First control-lock revision used a nonblocking lock, so concurrent cancellation caused both finish and its failure handling to fail.
remediated_findings.remediation: Short control critical sections use bounded retry while the main worker lock remains nonblocking.

remediated_findings.finding: A partial terminal result could be resealed on resume without independently reconstructing its patch and acceptance evidence.
remediated_findings.remediation: Recovery recomputes selected output and checks semantic equality before sealing; unrecoverable terminal runs remain preserved and refused.

remediated_findings.finding: A .git/commondir regular file could redirect object and ref reads to a separate repository despite normal-repository-only policy.
remediated_findings.remediation: Repository reads now reject commondir, gitdir, alternate stores, HTTP alternates and graft metadata before invoking Git.

remediated_findings.finding: Two generated bytecode files entered an intermediate package.
remediated_findings.remediation: Removed before final freeze; assembly rejects bytecode; exact release scan passed.

limits: Trusted local CLI and host, not OS isolation
Global Codex guidance may be inherited
No protection if code and manifests are replaced together
User-selected source is transmitted without automatic secret scrubbing
